body.message:
Hi, good morning.

I just wanted to let you know that I will be checking out and leaving the apartment tonight, August 20, although my booking is until August 21.

Since the booking and check-in process was done online, and when I checked in I did not meet anyone in person, could you please let me know what I should do with the key when I leave? Should I leave it inside the apartment, or hand it over to someone? Please let me know the checkout procedure.

Also, I paid a AED 2,000 security deposit. Could you please let me know when and how I can collect the deposit after checking out?

Thank you.
